We recognize that your family is facing some difficult times. Our goal is to provide you with the best understanding possible of all your options, the prognosis, and the risks associated with treatment.
When looking for a
pet oncologist
in the southwestern United States, Arizona Veterinary Oncology is your solution. We are the largest provider of dog oncology and cat oncology services in Arizona and regularly serve New Mexico, Texas, Nevada, Utah and even Mexico.

Meet Our Doctors
Dr. O’Connor
DVM, DACVIM
We are delighted to welcome Dr. O’Connor to the team at Arizona Veterinary Oncology. Outside of her professional endeavors, Dr. O’Connor is a devoted dog owner to two adorable rescues and a passionate sports fan. She enjoys watching football on Sundays and staying updated on the latest sports news.
Read Full Bio
Lynda Beaver
DVM, DACVIM (Medical Oncology)
Dr. Beaver received her DVM from the Ontario Veterinary College in 1989. After working as a general practitioner for a number of years, she decided to specialize in the field of veterinary oncology so she spent 4 years as an oncology technician at the University of Wisconsin-Madison.
Read Full Bio
Eric Boshoven
DVM, DACVR (Radiation Oncology)
Dr. Boshoven did his undergraduate work at the University of Arizona before acceptance at Colorado State University's College of Veterinary Medicine and Biomedical Sciences. After graduating in 1996, he worked in private practice in Tucson, Arizona for a year. A residency in Radiation Oncology ensued under the supervision of Dr. Mary K. Klein at Southwest Veterinary Oncology.

Vicki D
5.0 ★★★★★
Dr. Boshoven is AMAZING. A kind heart, a caring vet who seems to love what he does. He cares for others pets as if they're his own.  Every other staff member is great as well.  Kind, clean, caring facility.  I highly recommend Arizona Veterinary Oncology if you need it but I hope you don't.
Meghann Sherman
5.0 ★★★★★
Az Veterinary Oncology is a wonderful place to go in the toughest of times. Two of my dogs have been seen by Dr. Beaver, and I can 100% trust the information and advice she gives. I hope I never need to go back, but if I do, it comforts me to know this great place is so close by.
Terry Philips
5.0 ★★★★★
I cannot say enough good things about their care, concern and knowledge of the animals and their  owners. If I had a cancer diagnosis I would choose to go there! Talk about nice, caring, knowledgeable, sociable. I love everyone.
Everything is fresh and clean.
Gary Trevor
5.0 ★★★★★
Flawless in every manner.  One of my best experiences ever with my Rhodesian Ridgeback who had have surgery. My regular Vet. Is Power Road Animal Hospital in Mesa,  AZ.
Sheryl H-NMC
5.0 ★★★★★
We brought our dog here to explore treatment options for a mast cell tumor. The staff and vets here are wonderful, compassionate and helpful. Unfortunately, there was nothing they could do for our sweet doggo, but I was profoundly grateful for everything they did for us.
Gordon Barber
5.0 ★★★★★
Our baby Bruce was under the care of Dr Lynda Beaver and the staff.  We can't say enough about the compassion and care that Bruce and we received.  While we lost Bruce to this terrible word known as cancer, we're forever grateful that he received the care he did.
